facts.fact: Botswana's National Broadband Strategy (June 2018) states Botswana is connected to two submarine cables, EASSy and WACS, with the submarine cable landing stations reached through Namibia and South Africa, two different neighbouring countries.

note: Document does not pair each cable to a country; the two-neighbour reading rests on its phrase landing stations in Namibia and South Africa. It also says transit costs from the border to the landing stations remain high, which is not an access fact.
